//: Harsh Wilds feature 33, the white wisent (plan section 33, Open question 21; Prompt 48): a rare albino wisent that walks the wisent's own five oak glades. It is a variant manifest of Animals/Wisent.json in the musk ox herd pattern (Animals/MuskOx2.json): the framework has no population, so a second kind of wisent is a second manifest, and the two roam on their own. It is NEVER HOSTILE, which here means what it means for the wisent: no Aggression duty, so it never starts a fight, and the player who approaches it may still 'Leave it alone' (the encounter's EventSetup is FightOrEscape). It differs from Wisent.json in three things: it exists only on the days Tgr_HW_WhiteWisent rolls it in (the rolled hidden stat below), it has its own derived fight (hw_encounter_whitewisent, a stouter hide: blood 400) and its own derived carcass chain (hw_whitewisent_carcass, bled, skinned) whose 'Release the Spirit' pays BeastAffinity +100 where every other wild carcass pays vanilla's +25. Every number is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play. Card art is PARTIAL: the vanilla Cow sprites stand in until hw_whitewisent.png exists. A GENERATED agent (no Agent.Ref), so Carcass.Card applies.
//Switch: Spawn.Conditions (framework 2.27.0), ALL of which must hold: the rolled stat hw_stat_whitewisent reads 1 or more (only the White Wisent collection of SelfTriggeredAction/Tgr_HW_WhiteWisent.json writes it, 384 ticks, and it counts itself down), the switch hw_switch_whitewisent is 1 ([Threats] WhiteWisent), and the wisent switch hw_switch_wisent is 1 (the white wisent is a wisent: with [Threats] Wisent off none exists, as with the blood moon lynxes and the lynx switch). While one is false the framework keeps it retired in the Spirit World; it returns on the first tick all three hold again (ConditionRespawnTicks 0).
//Rare: DeathRespawnTicks 0: a killed white wisent stays dead until its condition next goes false and true again, which is the next roll that brings one. Killing it is therefore a once-in-a-long-while event; the carcass does not respawn on a timer.
//Blood: Agent.Blood.RatePerTick is 0, not vanilla's 0.17: the same reason as Animals/Wisent.json (the framework's lifecycle ticker counts the agent dead only while its blood sits at 4 or below, and regeneration would walk a killed animal back long before its respawn). Agent.Blood and PoisonResistance match the encounter's Blood 400 and Value4 200.
